info.title: Mailform Universal API
info.description: Send physical mail and manage API orders

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

file.description: PDF document to mail. Use this, Url, or Template as the document source.

url.description: URL of the PDF document to mail. Ignored if File is provided.

template.description: Mailform template identifier to use as the document source.

variables.description: JSON object of template variables. Used only when Template is provided.

customerReference.description: Optional customer reference to attach to the order.

service.description: Delivery service to use for the order.

webhook.description: Webhook URL for order update notifications.

company.description: Company ID to associate with the order.

simplex.description: Print one page per sheet when true; allow duplex when false.

color.description: Print in color when true; black and white when false.

flat.description: Require mailing in a flat envelope when true.

stamp.description: Require a real postage stamp when true.

returnEnvelope.description: Include a return envelope when true.

message.description: Message for postcard or notecard services.

qrcode.description: QR code to print on supported USPS postcard and first-class mail.

toOrganization.description: Organization or company associated with the recipient.

toAddress1.description: Street number and name of the recipient.

toAddress2.description: Suite, room, or secondary address for the recipient.

toPostcode.description: Postal or ZIP code of the recipient address.

fromOrganization.description: Organization or company associated with the sender.

fromAddress1.description: Street number and name of the sender.

fromAddress2.description: Suite, room, or secondary address for the sender.

fromPostcode.description: Postal or ZIP code of the sender address.
